result.brief: 提出无奖励持续学习框架，利用潜在状态世界模型冻结观测编码器与奖励预测器，仅通过无监督 rollout 更新转移动力学，使空间机器人在硬件退化下无需奖励即可在线适应。
result.reason: Latent-state world model with frozen encoder and reward predictor, adapting transition dynamics via unsupervised rollouts for robot control; world-model representation and dynamics learning contribution.
